evidence.observation: End-to-end map builder: it ranks the def/ref tags from get_ranked_tags, prepends important files, then binary-searches how many top-ranked tags fit in the token budget and returns the best rendered tree. It only ever sees the file lists handed to it, so any file that discovery already dropped as ignored/generated can never appear in the produced map - exactly the property the demo checks.

Builds the identifier graph: for every candidate file it calls Path(fname).is_file() (skipping missing files), extracts def/ref tags, records defines/references, builds a networkx MultiDiGraph and ranks definitions with pagerank. Relevant because symbol presence in the final map is driven by this def/ref (defines/references) intersection - the demo's relevant symbol render_code_map is a def that is referenced by src/app.py, so it survives ranking.

Extracts tags per file with tree-sitter queries, classifying captures as kind='def' (name.definition.*) or kind='ref' (name.reference.*), with a pygments backfill for defs-only files. It is the source of the symbols a code-map can contain; the demo's normalized operation reproduces this def/ref split using Python ast on the miniature repository.

Renders a single file's lines of interest (lois) into the elided code-map snippet, reading the file through self.io and caching by mtime. This is the function that emits the 'path:' plus definition lines that the demo asserts contains render_code_map and contains none of the ignored/generated file paths.

Public entry point that computes the max map token budget (wider when no chat files are present) and returns the rendered files_listing prefixed with repo_content_prefix. It defines the observable code-map contract the demo exercises: a text listing of files and their symbols.

Produces the discoverable file list from git (ls-files at HEAD plus staged files, cached per commit) and filters it with self.ignored_file(fname), so untracked/ignored/generated files never become map candidates. This is the ignore contract the demo's discovery step mirrors with mini_repo/.gitignore.

Memoized ignore predicate delegating to ignored_file_raw, whose gitwildmatch spec (pathspec GitWildMatchPattern) is the matcher the demo reuses to drop generated/, build/, *.log and ignored_secret.py from the miniature repository.

Executable demo driver: ensures the miniature repository, discovers non-ignored files, ranks tags, renders the code-map, evaluates the five presence/absence checks, writes demo-output.json and returns exit status 0 on pass.

The relevant symbol required to survive into the code-map: it is defined in the miniature repository, referenced by src/app.py, and therefore appears in the rendered map while all ignored/generated files are excluded.

claims.claim: aider builds a code-map by ranking def/ref tags into a rendered files_listing, and files never handed to RepoMap cannot appear in that listing; get_ranked_tags_map_uncached and get_ranked_tags implement this ranking pipeline.

Symbols enter a code-map only through tags produced by get_tags_raw, which classifies tree-sitter captures as def or ref, and are rendered per file by render_tree/to_tree; running the demo makes the def render_code_map present in the map text.

Ignored/generated files are excluded from aider's file discovery upstream of RepoMap via Repo.get_tracked_files and Repo.ignored_file; the demo reuses the same pathspec GitWildMatchPattern matcher and confirms those files are absent from the map even though they exist on disk.

The executable demo (.prale-eval/demo_code_map.py) over the miniature repository (.prale-eval/mini_repo/) passes all checks: relevant symbol render_code_map present, and build/artifact.py, generated/schema_pb2.py, ignored_secret.py, notes.log all absent.

conclusion: Executable demo mode is satisfied: building the code-map over the supplied miniature repository yields the relevant symbol render_code_map (src/codemap.py) while the ignored and generated files build/artifact.py, generated/schema_pb2.py, ignored_secret.py and notes.log are absent from the map despite existing on disk with their own hidden symbols. All five checks pass (exit 0). Because the environment lacks the optional runtime dependencies diskcache and grep_ast, aider.repomap.RepoMap itself cannot be imported; the demo records that limitation in demo-output.json and validation notes and uses a dependency-free normalized operation that preserves the contract's observable behaviour.

validation.notes: Exit status 0; all five checks printed PASS (relevant_file_present, relevant_symbol_present, ignored_files_exist_on_disk, ignored_files_absent, hidden_symbols_absent). The discovered files were README.md, src/__init__.py, src/app.py and src/codemap.py; the excluded files were build/artifact.py, generated/schema_pb2.py, ignored_secret.py and notes.log. LIMITATION: the real aider.repomap.RepoMap could not be imported because optional dependencies are unavailable (ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'diskcache'; grep_ast is also missing). No dependencies were installed, so the demo probes importability (upstream_repomap_importable=false, upstream_repomap_error recorded in .prale-eval/demo-output.json) and uses the dependency-free normalized operation documented in .prale-eval/demo-deliverable.md instead.
